notes.title: Game doesn´t work? Try THIS!! (2)
notes.content:
Here you are some tips from Crimson Wizard. Good luck, people!

First of all, let run "winsetup.exe" and try other video settings:
1) Windowed mode instead of fullscreen.
2) Switch between Direct Draw 5 and Direct 3D 9 graphics driver or OpenGL.

notes.title: Game doesn´t work? Try THIS!!
notes.content:
Hi, my friends. Jan the Wit thinks he has the solution. We are gonna copy and paste his tips:

The problem is that you cant't start the winsetup.exe and set the mode/resolution in the map ?:\SteamLibrary\SteamApps\common\SymplokeSteam\

Copy and Rename the symploke1.exe to symploke_English.exe and you can use the winsetup.exe to set your settings !! 

set both symploke1.exe and symploke_English.exe in the map to start the game in steam or in de map.
ːsteamhappyː
